set.body: Record owner direction: Sirin should be a Scala desktop UI platform with Native-first delivery and intended JVM shipping support, gated on a clear usability/elegance advantage over ScalaFX in matched representative applications. Define authoring, extension, interaction and comparison evidence; keep current headless support separate from unimplemented desktop hosting. Preserve concurrent graphics/native edits.
set.title: Vision: JVM product target and clear ScalaFX usability advantage
